name: Light Show
description: A home base for your Falcon Player (FPP) light show: what's playing, where the show is tonight, and how every controller is doing.
author: agent462

playerAddress.title: Show player
playerAddress.description: The address of the FPP player that runs your show, like 192.168.0.200 or fpp.local. The controllers are found through it.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: See-through shows your screen's background behind the module. The others match the full-screen calendar and weather themes.

covers.title: Look up album covers
covers.description: Finds each song's cover through Apple's free music search.

outlets.title: Controller outlets
outlets.description: Which Home Assistant outlet powers each controller. Set these in a Light Show module's settings, under Power.

remoteFalcon.title: Remote Falcon connected
remoteFalcon.description: Turned on when you connect Remote Falcon in a Light Show module's settings.

secrets.label: Remote Falcon key
secrets.description: Made for you when you connect Remote Falcon in a Light Show module's settings. There is nothing to type here.
